topic: Co-signing a loan vs paying cash (Mike vs Lisa)

scenes.narration: One signature can wreck your credit for seven full years. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera standing behind a tall courtroom bench pointing her gavel forward, a giant comic burst banner reads SEVEN YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mike and Lisa are both twenty eight years old.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man mike and woman lisa in cozy matching living rooms, both holding birthday cards reading TWENTY EIGHT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each gets a call to cosign a twelve thousand dollar auto loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both mike and lisa holding phones with chat bubbles reading COSIGN MY CAR LOAN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mike says yes without asking questions and signs the paperwork.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, mike at a car dealership desk signing a thick loan contract while a salesman smiles, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He never reads the clause about being equally responsible for the debt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a contract page with a red highlighted clause reading EQUAL RESPONSIBILITY, mike glossing past it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lisa says no but offers a two thousand dollar cash gift.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, lisa handing a small envelope of cash to a younger brother in a kitchen, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She tells her brother to build credit with a secured card first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a chalkboard behind lisa and her brother reading SECURED CARD FIRST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eight months later Mike's brother loses his job and stops paying.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, mike's brother holding a layoff notice, a missed payment alert on his phone, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The loan defaults and the bank comes after Mike for nine thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked mike opening a bank letter at a kitchen table, a giant red banner reading NINE THOUSAND OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mike's credit crashes one hundred twenty points for seven years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, mike staring at a falling credit score meter on his phone, calendar pages flipping forward seven years, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lisa's credit is untouched and her brother is still grateful.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, lisa hugging her brother in front of a small running used car, a clean credit score chart behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cosign means the debt is yours when they miss. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding a checklist labeled CO SIGN RULES, comic burst banner reads COURT DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
